svg.text: Koperasi Kegelapan — NFC NTAG215 Byte Layout
504B usable · 496B used (98.4%) · AES-256-GCM encrypted · HMAC-SHA256 signed · Dual-buffer atomic writes · Schema v4
Wire (NFC write): Active Buffer (216B) + Trailer (64B) = 280B — fits NTAG215 with headroom. Dual-buffer: write to INACTIVE → flip activePtr → power-loss safe.
4 NTAG pages — single read command for instant validation
Bytes 50–51: 2B reserved. 48B = 12 pages — one contiguous NFC burst read
Tamper detect: delta must match log
6 pages — only this + trailer written on debit/credit (fast NFC write)
4 pages. Bytes 100–103 reserved. Zeroed on checkout complete.
Chain verify: each Δ must match
Atomic update: flip after write OK
16 pages. Bytes 29–63 (35B) reserved. Written last → atomic commit guarantee.
AES-256-GCM (body) + HMAC-SHA256 (trailer) + monotonic counter + dual-buffer atomic writes + hash-chain log
All integers Little-Endian · Strings UTF-8 null-padded · Magic "KOPW" (0x4B4F5057)
